market_summary: All six instruments are exhibiting late New York session compression and low-volume consolidation following earlier directional expansions. Across FX (EURUSD, GBPUSD), precious metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD), and crypto (BTCUSD), prices are trapped below key session VWAPs and EMA baselines with low RVOL (grey bars) and neutral-to-bearish CVD momentum lacking catalytic triggers. US100 has flushed below its Gamma Flip into negative amplifying territory but is immediately confronting stacked support at S/R 28209, Put Wall #2 28199, and Globex VWAP 28193, offering inadequate clearance for clean trend continuation. Strict capital preservation warrants a HOLD across the entire portfolio.
